Name: Animal Squeeze Through - Ostriches in Coops and more
Author: zombifier
Description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: Make sure to update to Extra Animal Config's latest version as well. It fixes some bugs in the multi-animal house feature.

Saddened that ostriches (or turkeys or geese) has to live in barns with other stinky livestock instead of their egg-laying poultry brethren simply because they're too big for the teeny coop door? Annoyed that you have to put mayo machines in two different locations? This mod is for you!

It does a few things:

[list]
[*]Allow big animals to fit through smaller doors (NOTE: You can use Extra Animal Config as a dependency instead of this mod!)[/*]
[*]Allow ostriches, as well as some modded poultry like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Mount Vapius[/url]﻿' Geese and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkeys[/url]﻿ to live in both coops and barns. This requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Config[/url] which provides the multi-animal house feature that this mod uses.[/*]
[*]Allow rabbits to live in barns as well as coops. Get that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]grass-eating[/url]﻿ mammal outta here![/*]
[/list]
The following big birds are supported:
[list]
[*]Vanilla Ostriches[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Mount Vapius[/url]﻿' Geese and Stellar Geese[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkeys[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25134]birdb's Geese[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18142]Ilucie's Emu[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28834]Red-Crowned Crane[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3634]Trent's New Animals[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24316]BVG Animal Overhaul[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36681]Water Flamingos[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]The Flamingos in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20525]Otter's Additional Barn Animals[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43463]Em's River Wildlife[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41595]Em's Hedgehogs[/url][/*]
[/list]
Suggestions for other modded big birds are welcome.

[s]Other modders are free to add this mod as a dependency if they have oversized animals they wish to put in the vanilla coops/barns.[/s] As of the latest version of Extra Animal Config, that functionality is merged, and this mod is no longer necessary! Just download EAC and you're good to go.
 
Source code: [url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/AnimalSqueezeThrough]https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/AnimalSqueezeThrough[/url]

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Scarlett28?gameId=1303]Scarlett[/url] for help on much of the compat!

KNOWN ISSUE:
[list]
[*]If you purchased big birds after installing a version of this mod that's older than 1.0.4, when you uninstall this mod you cannot move them between Barns. This is an extremely minor edge case that shouldn't happen as long as you keep this mod installed, and will not affect big birds purchased after updating this mod to 1.0.4.[/*]
[/list]FAQ:
Q: I'm one of 5 people on Earth that picked Coopmaster, would this work with them?
A: Yes! On the otherhand, Shepherd will no longer work with them. This is regardless of where they live.
Q: What mods are you using in the screenshot?
A: See below:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Interface[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Mizu's Turkeys and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028?tab=description]Quails[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Several outfits from [url=https://ko-fi.com/lune/shop]Lune[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]
